title: Stride-k Subsampling: Train-Free Audio Token Reduction for Whisper
abstract: arXiv:2608.30927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whisper exposes speech through a fixed 1500-token encoder interface, now a default representation for ASR decoders and Whisper-based speech language models (SpeechLMs), yet its redundancy remains largely unexamined. We propose stride-k subsampling, a deterministic indexing operation that retains every k-th token after the convolutional stem or encoder transformer. Across five Whisper scales, k=2 preserves baseline WER at both positions, with CKA attributing this stability to acoustic overlap at the stem and attention-induced redistribution at the encoder output. Applying stride-2 at both positions cuts audio tokens by 75% and total GFLOPs by 52-58%, with small WER costs on most ASR benchmarks and larger costs on harder ones. The same configuration extends to three Whisper-based SpeechLMs, yielding modest accuracy drops on stronger baselines and larger drops on weaker ones, while reducing end-to-end latency by 19.6-27.4%. translated_title: 步长k子采样：面向Whisper的无训练音频Token缩减方法
translated_abstract: Whisper通过一个固定的1500-token编码器接口来呈现语音，这已成为ASR解码器和基于Whisper的语音语言模型（SpeechLM）的默认表示形式，但其冗余性在很大程度上尚未被研究。我们提出步长k子采样，这是一种确定性的索引操作，在卷积主干或编码器Transformer之后每隔k个token保留一个。在五个Whisper模型规模上，k=2在两个位置均能保持基线词错误率（WER），CKA分析将这种稳定性归因于主干处的声学重叠以及编码器输出处由注意力引起的重新分布。在两个位置应用步长2可将音频token减少75%，总GFLOPs减少52-58%，在大多数ASR基准上仅带来很小的WER损失，而在较难的基准上损失较大。相同的配置可扩展到三个基于Whisper的SpeechLM，在较强基线上产生适度的精度下降，在较弱基线上下降较大，同时将端到端延迟降低19.6-27.4%。该方法无需任何训练。
tldr: 提出一种无需训练的步长k子采样方法，在Whisper的卷积主干或编码器输出处每隔k个token保留一个，可将音频token减少75%、总GFLOPs减少52-58%，同时基本保持词错误率不变，并可扩展到SpeechLM实现19.6-27.4%的端到端延迟降低。
en_tdlr: Proposes stride-k subsampling, a train-free deterministic indexing operation that retains every k-th token in Whisper, cutting audio tokens by 75% and total GFLOPs by 52-58% while preserving baseline WER, and extends to Whisper-based SpeechLMs with 19.6-27.4% end-to-end latency reduction.
